changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwdiagnostictestprofile AS SELECT dtp.id, dtp.test_id, dtp.name, dtp.result_unit, dtp.result_type, dtp.list_of_value_id, dtp.is_default, dtp.is_active FROM public.diagnostic_test_profile dtp;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwdiagnostictestprofile TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwdiagnostictestprofile FROM report_user;
